name: Emperor Sanjō
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 68); Porter’s note gives the dates as: reigned 1012–1015.

poems.title: If in this troubled world of ours
poems.author: Emperor Sanjō
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 68
poems.text:
If in this troubled world of ours
I still must linger on,
My only friend shall be the moon,
Which on my sadness shone,
When other friends were gone.
